source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: As your Command phase ends, roll a D6 for every objective marker under your control where at least one of your units bearing this ability is in range; each 4+ gives you 1 **Miracle dice** whose value is the number rolled.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

roll.per: controlled objective marker with a friendly unit bearing this ability in range
